items.hed: Rockets beat Oklahoma City 119-98 at Toyota Center to go 6-1
items.insight: NBA.com final, Saturday, Oct. 31: Houston 119, Oklahoma City 98. Jabari Smith Jr. led the Rockets with 30 points and Marcus Smart added 24. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 26 for the Thunder, now 4-2. Boston visits Toyota Center on Monday, Nov. 2, at 8:30 p.m. ET.

items.hed: Texans are off this Sunday for the Week 8 bye; the Chargers are next on Nov. 8
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Week 8, the weekend of Nov. 1, as the bye. Week 9 is Sunday, Nov. 8, at the Los Angeles Chargers, SoFi Stadium, 3:05 p.m. CT on CBS. Then come Cleveland on Nov. 15 and a Thursday night home game against Indianapolis on Nov. 19 on Prime Video.

items.hed: Astros' offseason so far: six players elected free agency, one release
items.insight: MLB's official transaction log lists six Astros electing free agency on Oct. 29: right-hander Bryan Abreu, center fielder Daulton Varsho, catcher Christian Vázquez, first baseman LaMonte Wade Jr., right-hander Enyel De Los Santos, and left-hander Steven Okert. Houston released left fielder Nelson Velázquez on Oct. 27. No Astros moves have posted since.
